# Mostly Daily

> Mostly Daily: Forgiving Habits. A habit tracker that forgives: miss a day, keep your progress. Levels instead of fragile streaks, rest days that count as rest, a mosaic of your check-ins, and Limit habits with a colour calendar. No account, no ads, no tracking.

- Platform: iPhone. Coming soon to the App Store. The site and the app are in English only.
- Developer: Uladzimir Kazakevich. Contact: contact@mostlydaily.com
- Price: free to download. Free includes 3 habits (one can be a Limit habit) with no time limit. Premium (14-day free trial) adds unlimited habits with Focus mode (5 in focus at a time), the evening Lock Screen check-in, every past reflection and recap, more widgets, themes and app icons, two reminder times per habit and a suggested better time. Premium Family shares Premium with you and up to 5 family members through Apple Family Sharing, with no accounts and no invites. When Premium ends nothing is deleted. Prices are shown in the App Store.
- How it works: each habit has a consistency level (Starting, Sometimes, Often, Mostly; Mostly is the top). One miss never resets anything; the "never missed twice" run ends only after two misses in a row. Rest, low energy and travel days are not misses. Build habits (yes or no, a count, or minutes) can check themselves off from Apple Health (steps, exercise minutes, workouts, mindful minutes, sleep, stand hours, water). Drinks can be kept in Apple Health: the app reads what other apps logged and saves the ones you log. Limit habits (drinks, sugar, screen time) get a colour calendar of clear, lighter and heavier days and a goal of clear days a week; the control is a square button, with no checkmark.
- App: three tabs (Today, Reflect, Settings). On Today, Edit reorders, pauses or archives habits and the + button adds a habit with quick add (a name and Add). Tap the ring on a habit to check in; tap again to undo. Every check-in lands one tile in the habit's colour in the mosaic on Today; a mosaic is 100 tiles, it is kept, and the next one starts. Reflect tells you about your week in kind words.
- Widgets: one control per widget; check in without opening the app. Free: Habit (small; choose a Limit habit for the square button and the evening, clear-day and drinks view), Next up (small; shows the mosaic when every habit is done), Today (medium), Lock Screen widgets, StandBy, tinted and clear Home Screen styles, Control Center controls (Check in, Clear day, Close the day), Siri and Shortcuts. Premium adds Today and week (large), Month calendar (small and large), This week (medium and large) and Who you're becoming (the mosaic).
- Privacy: no account, no server, no analytics, no tracking. Habits, the check-ins you make yourself for Build habits and time off sync through the user's private iCloud. Check-ins that come from Apple Health and every log of drinks stay on the device and are never put in iCloud; drink and cigarette logs never sync, and other Limit habit logs stay on the device unless the user turns on "Sync logs through iCloud" for that habit (off by default). The reason given for time off stays on the device. Apple Health access is optional and per habit.
- Not a medical, treatment or recovery app.
